text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co Inc said on Monday that it named Herbert Allison Jr. as president and chief operating officer, and John Steffens as vice chairman, both effective April 15, 1997.
Most recently, Allison was executive vice president of the corporate and institutional client group at Merrill Lynch. He has been with the firm for 25 years.

Allison will succeed David Komansky, who is set to become chief executive at the end of this month and chairman in mid April. Komansky has been designated to succeed Chairman and Chief Executive Daniel Tully.
Steffens, who has been with Merrill Lynch for 33 years, has headed the company's private client group for the past 11 years. He is to continue in that role, Merrill said.
Current Vice Chairman Stephen Hammerman will remain in that post.
